de_xuat.co_che: Nha dau tu to chuc (index fund) phai mua lai khi gia dao luyen khoi vung trung binh de duy tri ty le quyen loi, va ho tra phi qua dem thong qua toc do hoi ve nhanh hon chi phi tai chinh 5-7%/nam trong che do bien dong thap.
de_xuat.dieu_kien_sai: Bien dong nam trong top 30% hoac xu huong tang/giam duoi 10 bar lien tuc

de_xuat.co_che: Quỹ macro hedge fund xoay truong sang tai san co muc doi dien gia lam mat gia tri tien te, chi chiu phi qua dem 5-7%/nam vi chi so loai bo cac ky han co su thay doi loi suat am, bao bo chi phi tai chinh bang alpha tu xu huong dai han.
de_xuat.dieu_kien_sai: Loi suat 10 nam giam qua 2% trong 20 bar gan nhat

de_xuat.co_che: Nha giao dich don bay va maker thanh ly lenh dung lo sau khi quet thanh cao cu, chi chiu phi qua dem ngan han vi tin hieu dao chieu xay ra nhanh, phi tai chinh duoc bu boi toc do quay ve trung binh khi thanh khuan gap.
de_xuat.dieu_kien_sai: Xu huong tang manh (do dai > 15 bar) hoac bien dong thu hep (phan_vi atr < 0.1)

de_xuat.co_che: Nha tao lap quyen chon (market maker) ban call khi bien dong ngan han gian no vuot nguong, chi chiu phi qua dem ngan han vi posotion hedging tu dong khi bien dong quay ve, phi tai chinh duoc bao bo boi premium ban quyen.
de_xuat.dieu_kien_sai: Xu huong dai han (do dai > 30 bar) khong dao chieu

de_xuat.co_che: So do thuc thi lenh (execution desk) cua quy tuong ho tich luy tai muc ho tro dai han, chi chiu phi qua dem 30 bar vi chi phi tai chinh duoc bu boi toc do gia quay ve khi thanh khuan cuc cao cho thay ap luc ban da het.
de_xuat.dieu_kien_sai: Gia dong cua nam duoi 50% than nen

de_xuat.co_che: Fund giao dich so hoc (stat arb) phai trung hoa sai lech gia tri tuyet doi giua hai tai san co quan he tinh theo thoi gian thuc, chi chiu phi qua dem 15 bar vi phi tai chinh duoc bu boi toc do hoi ve trung binh khi sai lech vuot nguong 2 do lech chuan.
de_xuat.dieu_kien_sai: Xu huong nam trong che do dao dong (do dai < 10 bar) hoac zscore am

ly_do_chon: Tat ca 6 co che deu duoc thiet ke theo dang 'A KHI B' ket hop dieu kien che do (phan_vi cua bien dong/khoi luong/do dai xu huong) voi dieu kien vao/ra, gom theo kinh nghiem 1.700 phep thu truoc do. Moi co che dinh ro ai la ben chiu phi qua dem (index fund, macro hedge, market maker, execution desk, stat arb) va co che nao bu chi phi 5-7%/nam (toc do hoi ve, premium quyen, alpha xu huong, hedging tu dong). Khong su dung nguong tuyet doi cho gia/ATR/khoi luong, thay bang phan_vi/zscore/do_lech de dam bao kha nang kiem dinh va ty le kich hoat nam trong khoang 0.5%-40%. Gia tri giu <=20 bar de giam toc do tieu hao phi qua dem, cac truong hop >20 bar da co giai thich truong trong co_che.
